name: pmkusum_generate_otp
description: Sends OTP to the Aadhaar-linked mobile number for PM-KUSUM authentication. First step in authentication flow. Does NOT verify the OTP or create a session. Fails if Aadhaar is invalid or mobile not registered.

name: pmkusum_verify_otp
description: Verifies the OTP and returns a session_token for PM-KUSUM operations. Does NOT check eligibility or application status. Fails if OTP is expired, incorrect, or not generated via pmkusum_generate_otp.

name: pmkusum_check_eligibility
description: Checks farmer's eligibility for PM-KUSUM solar pump subsidy based on land ownership, irrigation land access, and non-duplication criteria. Returns eligibility_status ('eligible' or 'not_eligible') with reasons. Requires session_token. Does NOT submit application. Fails if farmer has no valid land records or has already received a solar pump subsidy.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

state.description: State where the farmer's land is located.

land_area_hectares.description: Total irrigable land area in hectares.

name: pmkusum_apply_subsidy
description: Submits a solar pump subsidy application under PM-KUSUM. Transitions application_status from 'not_applied' to 'submitted'. Requires eligibility check first. Requires session_token. Does NOT approve the application or select vendors. Fails if farmer is not eligible, a duplicate application exists, or land details are invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

pump_capacity_hp.description: Capacity of the solar pump in HP.

land_parcel_id.description: Unique identifier of the irrigation land parcel.

name: pmkusum_calculate_subsidy
description: Calculates the subsidy breakdown for a PM-KUSUM application showing central share, state share, and farmer contribution. Subsidy percentage and rules vary by state. Requires session_token. Does NOT process payment or approve application. Fails if application_id is invalid or application is in 'rejected' state.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

application_id.description: Unique identifier of the subsidy application.

name: pmkusum_check_application_status
description: Returns the current application_status ('not_applied', 'submitted', 'under_review', 'approved', 'rejected') with remarks. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify the application. Fails if application_id is invalid or does not belong to the authenticated farmer.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

application_id.description: Unique identifier of the subsidy application.

name: pmkusum_get_vendor_list
description: Returns a list of empanelled vendors available in the farmer's region for solar pump installation. Requires session_token. Does NOT select or assign a vendor. Fails if no vendors are available in the specified region.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmkusum_select_vendor
description: Selects an empanelled vendor for solar pump installation. Transitions vendor_status from 'not_selected' to 'selected'. Requires session_token. Application must be in 'approved' state. Does NOT schedule installation. Fails if vendor_id is invalid, vendor is not empanelled, or application is not approved.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

application_id.description: Unique identifier of the subsidy application.

vendor_id.description: Unique identifier of the empanelled vendor.

name: pmkusum_schedule_installation
description: Schedules the solar pump installation with the selected vendor. Transitions installation_status from 'not_started' to 'scheduled'. Requires session_token. Vendor must be selected first. Does NOT perform installation or verify it. Fails if vendor is not selected or scheduling conflicts exist.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

application_id.description: Unique identifier of the subsidy application.

preferred_date.description: Preferred installation date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: pmkusum_track_installation
description: Tracks the installation progress of the solar pump. Returns installation_status ('not_started', 'scheduled', 'in_progress', 'completed', 'verified') and vendor details. Requires session_token. Does NOT verify installation or release subsidy. Fails if application_id is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

application_id.description: Unique identifier of the subsidy application.

name: pmkusum_verify_installation
description: Records the physical verification/inspection result for the installed solar pump. Transitions installation_status from 'completed' to 'verified' upon passing. Verification is REQUIRED before subsidy disbursement. Requires session_token. Does NOT disburse subsidy. Fails if installation is not 'completed', inspection finds defects, or installation is incomplete.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

application_id.description: Unique identifier of the subsidy application.

name: pmkusum_track_subsidy
description: Tracks the subsidy disbursement status. Returns subsidy_status ('not_initiated', 'pending', 'disbursed', 'failed') with transaction details. Subsidy is released ONLY after verified installation. Requires session_token. Does NOT initiate disbursement. Fails if installation is not verified.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

application_id.description: Unique identifier of the subsidy application.

name: pmkusum_get_grid_connection_status
description: Checks the grid connection status for grid-connected solar pump installations. Only applicable for 'grid_connected' type. Requires session_token. Does NOT establish grid connection. Fails if the installation is 'off_grid' type or not yet completed.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

application_id.description: Unique identifier of the subsidy application.

name: pmkusum_raise_grievance
description: Raises a grievance related to PM-KUSUM. Valid categories: 'application_rejected', 'installation_delay', 'vendor_issue', 'subsidy_not_received', 'inspection_failure'. Farmer must check application/subsidy status first. Requires session_token. Does NOT resolve grievances. Fails if category is invalid or duplicate exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: pmkusum_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks a previously raised PM-KUSUM grievance. Returns resolution status, assigned officer, and remarks. Requires session_token. Does NOT raise new grievances. Fails if grievance_id is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
